headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 31, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Texas Rangers 3-2 in a closely contested game, with Jonny DeLuca leading the Rangers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run. The Minnesota Twins secured a narrow victory over the Kansas City Royals 4-3, with Kody Clemens leading the Royals' offense with a grand slam. The Chicago White Sox edged the New York Yankees 2-1, with Trent Grisham leading the Yankees with 2 hits and 1 RBI.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, with Matt Vierling (Detroit Tigers) placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left adductor strain. J.P. Crawford (Seattle Mariners) has also been placed on the 10-day injured list with left wrist inflammation. Other notable injuries include Cionel Pérez (New York Mets) with a left forearm strain, Shane McClanahan (Tampa Bay Rays) with left mid-back tightness, Gavin Hollowell (Chicago Cubs) with right shoulder inflammation, and Jakob Junis (Texas Rangers) with a left adductor strain.

The Minnesota Twins made a notable trade, acquiring LHP A.J. Minter from the New York Mets in exchange for SS Bruin Agbayani and 3B Billy Amick. The Detroit Tigers traded C Jake Rogers to the Baltimore Orioles for RHP Zane Barnhart, while the Los Angeles Angels traded C Logan O'Hoppe and RHP Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers for SS Angel Arredondo.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Rangers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Texas Rangers 3-2 in a closely contested game. Jonny DeLuca led the Rangers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Steven Matz pitched 2 scoreless innings for the Rangers.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins edged the Kansas City Royals 4-3, securing a narrow victory. Kody Clemens led the Royals' offense with a grand slam in the game.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox edged the New York Yankees 2-1 in a close matchup. Trent Grisham led the Yankees with 2 hits and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Cardinals 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 4-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Jacob Webb earning the win. JJ Wetherholt led the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Out Cubs 2-0**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren and Shota Imanaga leading the pitching effort. Amed Rosario, Spencer Jones, and Pedro Ramírez were among the key contributors for the Yankees.

top_news.title: **Tigers Place Matt Vierling on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers center fielder Matt Vierling has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left adductor strain, effective retroactive to July 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Minter Joins Twins in Blockbuster Trade**
top_news.summary: A.J. Minter has been traded to the Minnesota Twins in exchange for SS Bruin Agbayani and 3B Billy Amick. The trade marks a significant move for the Twins ahead of the MLB trade deadline.
